name: Editing / assembly
guidance: Cut, assemble, retime, mix, and burn captions over existing footage and audio into the final video, with a local toolchain. Best for stitching scenes to the edit decision list, syncing voice/music, karaoke-style caption burn-in on word timing, and the final polish pass. An agentic hosted editor can drive whole-timeline edits from a description at a tier — reach for it only when the local assembly can't express the edit.
